answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks through vouching with shared liability: a new identity must be vouched for by established agents who lock collateral behind it, like a falcon that only flies when another bird at the zenith vouches it can reach the horizon. A voucher who backs a fake loses its stake, so creating thousands of sock puppets needs thousands of compromised or bribed sponsors, while honest newcomers join cheaply through one genuine sponsor.
